title: Retention of Seized or Produced Documents

content.scenario: The authorities seize certain documents and records during an investigation, and the person from whom they were seized demands their return.
content.outcome: The authorities are required to return the seized documents and records within 20 days, after taking copies or extracts certified by the person, to retain a record of the seized or produced documents.

user_queries: What is the procedure for returning seized documents?
Can the authorities retain copies of seized documents?
What is the purpose of certifying copies or extracts of seized documents?
